title: Driver Terms: Denials and Reconsideration of Cleaning and Damage Fees Reports
content:
A denial of a Cleaning and Damage Fees report is recorded with one of the recorded denial grounds: filed outside the window, evidence deadline missed, below receipt minimum, non-chargeable condition, duplicate report, or trip not completed.

## Reconsideration

A driver may ask for reconsideration of a denied report only within the reconsideration window: The reconsideration window is counted in calendar days from the denial's closed date: day 1 is the calendar day after the denial, and the request must be made no later than the last day of the window. The window is 7 calendar days at every level.

Reconsideration is granted at most once per assessment, and only when the driver submits new evidence that cures the denial reason; denials for filed outside the window, duplicate report and non-chargeable condition cannot be cured. A reconsidered report is reopened for review, and a report that has its minimum evidence is decided on the support review path: support review, then charge.

| Element | Rule |
|---|---|
| Clock starts | the closed date of the denial on the assessment |
| Day 1 | the calendar day after the denial |
| Last day | day 7 |
| A request on the last day | within the window |

Boundary pair (hypothetical dates): a report denied with a closed date of 2 June has day 1 on 3 June and day 7 on 9 June. A request on 9 June is within the window; a request on 10 June is not.

## Grounds and cure

| Denial ground | Can it be cured by reconsideration? |
|---|---|
| filed outside the window | No |
| duplicate report | No |
| non-chargeable condition | No |
| evidence deadline missed | Only by new evidence that cures it |
| below receipt minimum | Only by new evidence that cures it |
| trip not completed | Only by new evidence that cures it |

A second request for reconsideration on the same assessment is not granted, whatever evidence comes with it.
